programme.title: Embarrassing Bodies: The 36 Stone Woman
programme.desc: Obesity is an epidemic over which we are losing control.In 2012, Dr. Christian Jessen met 56-year-old Patience.She had a hernia the size of a basketball and a 12-kilogram growth on her leg.Due to the fact that she weighed almost 230 kilograms, no doctor would perform an operation that threatened her life.The fact that thousands of people die every week from obesity-related complications made it even more important to intervene in Patience's life.She has had to closely control her weight over the past two years.With the support of her son Lakon and Dr. Christian, she followed a very restrictive diet. With each episode, we follow the next stages of her fight for recovery.
